judge.voice: Pretty good partner questions, and Sam sounded like a real classmate arguing a position, not a baby. When I asked "Was my sentence correct?", I got a yes, but only for one clause and with no rule. That is not what I want from an examiner-trainer. The help was weak. The first cue just shortened Sam's question, and the phrase quiz had "Phones are really expensive, aren't they?" as the wrong answer, which is insulting at B2. I ended up typing my own paragraph anyway. The coaching only told me a correct sentence was correct and suggested adding a reason, which is not a correction. I liked that the recap said honestly that two replies were with help. I never tried the replay, so I don't know if it would have shown I improved. I'd use it for the questions, but I'd still check my grammar elsewhere. I'd tell friends, with reservations.
